title: Carrier Onboarding Checklist
subtitle: Carrier Onboarding: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Carrier Onboarding Checklist covers carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval. The carrier onboarding coordinator records Carrier Onboarding criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Carrier Onboarding Checklist keeps Carrier Onboarding exceptions visible until the carrier onboarding coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Carrier Onboarding Checklist at carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository. Document carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval identity before Carrier Onboarding begins. Compare carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval findings with stated Carrier Onboarding criteria; route unresolved Carrier Onboarding issues to authorized carrier-compliance reviewer. For Carrier Onboarding Checklist, confirm requirements for Carrier Onboarding. Ask authorized carrier-compliance reviewer to review Carrier Onboarding conditions beyond the carrier onboarding coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Carrier Onboarding, identify responsible parties, carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository, and the linked carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval source.

fields.label: Authority, tax, insurance, and vendor identifiers
Dispatch, safety, claims, billing, and after-hours contacts

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Onboarding facts for carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Carrier Onboarding inspection checks
items: Insurance type, limit, term, and source
Safety, security, tracking, and cargo controls
Payment, fraud, identity, and communication verification
Approval scope, conditions, expiration, and re-review

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Carrier Onboarding, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Carrier Onboarding Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Identity or ownership cannot be verified
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Onboarding when carrier identity, authority, insurance, fraud control, or authorized approval remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Onboarding proof and route unresolved carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval scope to carrier onboarding coordinator.
